description: Acko is India's #1 insurance app and a leading digital-first insurer. Acko offers car, bike, health, life, and travel insurance with a focus on simplicity, fast claims, and zero commission. 12+ million app downloads, 98.8% claims settled in 1 week, 7-minute fastest claim settlement. Products include comprehensive motor insurance, term life (₹25L–₹100Cr), health insurance from ₹600/month, international travel insurance in 150+ countries, domestic AirPass, and enterprise solutions. Free services: challan check, FASTag recharge, PUC check, ABHA card, will creation. Best direct insurer 2025. Trusted by millions of customers for hassle-free online insurance.
